caveats: Values are preserved as returned by Longbridge; do not reinterpret units (e.g. NFP scale) without source verification.
release_at is usable for causal alignment, but forecast vintage/revision history is not independently certified here.
Missing months/forecasts remain missing and are not imputed.
Raw actual-forecast surprise is not comparable across indicators; any model should standardize using training-only history.
